HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e., November ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e., November 14, 2026, has approved the dissolution of the Rights Issue Committee with immediate effect i.e., November 14, 2026.
The Rights Issue Committee was originally constituted by the Board of Directors to oversee, decide upon, and execute matters relating to the Company''s Rights Issue of equity shares. Since the Rights Issue has been duly completed and all related formalities, including the listing and trading approvals, have been concluded, the purpose for which the Committee was formed stands fulfilled.
This intimation is also uploaded on the Company website i.e., www.gennexlab.com.
We request you to take the above information on record and acknowledge receipt of the same.
NEWSSUB: Intimation Regarding Dissolution Of The Rights Issue Committee Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
